name: Takano Sachiho
source: A second-year student at Yaesaka. Sickly by nature, with an introverted and gentle personality. She also treats Hatsune, who masquerades as an exchange student, with kindness. She is Takahiro's childhood friend, and rumor has it the two like each other.
